_comment: Placeholder sf_id — replace with a real Salesforce Case Id (15/18-char, starts 500...), or ignore this file and use `--sf-case <id>` to pull a live Case. With SF creds in .env the sf_writeback + ask_human(chatter) nodes write for real; without creds they dry-run (log the intended calls).
subject: Prorated charge looks wrong after mid-cycle plan upgrade
body: We moved from Team to Professional on the 12th and the invoice shows a full-period charge, not a prorated one. Please confirm how proration is calculated and whether this invoice is correct.
